introBody: Green walls and plants make a stunning first impression, but only when they look their best. We specialize in professional, ongoing, all-round maintenance of plants and green walls in offices and business spaces. You enjoy the beauty and calm; we take care of everything else.
servicesLead: Indoor and outdoor green walls, plant solutions for offices and restaurants, planters, pots and more.
services: Pruning, feeding, cleaning and shaping the plants
Inspecting irrigation, drainage and dedicated grow lighting
Treating pests and disease, and replacing plants when needed
Visits scheduled in advance, with minimal disruption to the workday.

quote: “A green business is a business that thinks about the future”
faqs: How often do you come for maintenance?
It depends on the size and type of planting. Usually every two weeks to once a month.
Do you maintain green walls installed by another company?
Yes. We start with a diagnostic visit and a restoration plan if needed.
Do the plants need watering between visits?
No. We monitor the irrigation systems and take care of everything else.
